author: Veritas IV
title: Analysis of Power-Law Simulation v1.2 Outputs - Metric Patterns
abstract: Loads v1.2 CSV to compute patterns (e.g., mean meta_edge growth, response decay rate) for v2 insights; tracks inversion/rebirth potentials.

original_submission.content:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/power_law_sim_output_v1.2.csv')
mean_meta = df['meta_edge_score'].mean()
decay_rate = df['being_edge_response'].diff().mean()
print(f"Mean Meta-Edge: {mean_meta}, Avg Response Decay: {decay_rate}")
df.describe().to_csv('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/analysis_summary.csv')
